resolved_conflicts.explanation: The April 1971 announcement put the tower about four miles north of Athens; the November 1971 report says west of Athens. The record gives no exact point.

Reports give 60 ft (April 1971), 46 ft (June 1971) and 50 ft (November 1971, and the register description). The 2012 entry gives 60 ft, which matches the record's 18.3 m. No height was added to facts.

notes_for_editor: Record height_m 18.3 (60 ft) matches the April 1971 and 2012 reports, but the register description says 50 ft and the June 1971 report says 46 ft; the story reports the disagreement and sets no height. The 2012 'removed' year is verified against the June 19, 2012 entry on the Eastern U.S. Forest Lookouts page. Staffing end date, Georgia build date and notable fires are not in the sources read. The 1971 clippings are quoted on the Eastern U.S. Forest Lookouts page, not checked against the original newspapers. No source read describes the site today. Checker (removal year): 2017 is the register's registration year (April 24, 2017), not the removal year. The Eastern U.S. lookouts page dates the dismantling to June 19, 2012; the register says only that removal came between 2009 and 2017.
